note: Set B's fourteen shown claims are all faithful to Table 6-1: values, units (N·m², kg·m, N) and elevation/HtFract conditions match the source, and it captures the integrated mass center (38.234 m) that A omits. Set A repeatedly misreads the bending/torsional stiffness unit as N·m³ (six claims), misreads the TwFAIner label as "TwFAlner" twice, repeats the base TwFAStif fact, and identifies rows only as "row 1/row 2" instead of elevations. A does correctly report the TwEAStif column and the 8.76 m row, which B leaves out, but its shown error rate (8 of 15) is far higher than B's (0 of 14).
remarks: A's stiffness units are written N*m^3 where the table header reads (N•m2) — a systematic unit misread, and the quoted text in those claims restates the wrong unit, so the quotes do not support the claims as written. A's "TwFAlner" is a capital-I/lowercase-l confusion of the column label TwFAIner (2 claims); values are bound to the right column. A also states the base TwFAStif fact twice (claims 1 and 13). B's mass-center claim gives the condition "along the tower centerline relative to the tower base", which completes a sentence cut off at "along the" at the bottom of this page part; the value 38.234 m is supported, but the condition is an extrapolation beyond the visible text. Coverage gaps differ: A omits the integrated center-of-mass height and the top/base TwGJStif, TwSSStif, TwSSIner, TwFAcgOf entries; B omits the whole TwEAStif column and all 8.76 m row entries. Both sets leave TMassDen (5590.87 kg/m at the base, etc.) unclaimed in the shown samples.
